description: Voarq helps architecture firms manage day-to-day operations directly in ChatGPT. Review projects, deadlines, tracked time, clients, Weekly Direction, and financial data. Create and update projects, clients, schedules, notes, expenses, proposals, timers, project stages, client access, notifications, and public app content. Voarq analyzes current office context before higher-impact changes and asks for confirmation when needed. Weekly Direction is read-only and cannot be deleted or regenerated through the plugin. Account settings, passwords, security, subscriptions, billing, and external money transfers are outside the plugin's scope.

defaultPrompt: Como está meu escritório hoje? Analise projetos, prazos, financeiro, tempo e Direção Semanal e diga a prioridade.
Quero criar um novo projeto. Pergunte apenas o que estiver faltando e crie quando todas as informações estiverem completas.
Analise meus projetos atrasados e diga quais clientes devo contatar antes de alterar qualquer cronograma.
